periods.description: A New Kingdom academy in Crossfield for training Drag-Knight officer candidates and officials, formerly all-female until Lux is accepted.
periods.history: Founded after the coup because data showed women possessed strong Drag-Ride aptitude and the New Kingdom needed trained personnel after old imperial users died or were removed.
periods.goals: Train Drag-Knights and officers, protect Crossfield, support ruin defense, and prepare students for military and civil service.
periods.structure: Headmistress Relie, instructors such as Regrie, student classes, dormitory, hangar, workshop, and the Knight Squadron.
